## Model Details

This model is an int4 (W4A16, group_size 128, symmetric) model of [Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) with 200 tuning iterations. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (W4A16)**: self-attention projections, linear-attention projections, MLP, and the multi-token-prediction block
- **Kept in BF16**: embeddings, lm_head, vision tower, normalization layers, linear-attention input gates

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
pip install vllm==0.33.0 transformers==5.20.2
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
vllm serve INCModel4/Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound \
    --dtype bfloat16 \
    --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
    --language-model-only
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | W4A16 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| PIQA | 80.90 | 80.85 | 99.93% |
| HellaSwag | 63.77 | 63.18 | 99.08% |
| MMLU | 82.67 | 82.05 | 99.25% |
| GSM8K | 97.27 | 96.51 | 99.22% |
| **Average** | **81.15** | **80.65** | **99.38%** |

## Generate the Model

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \
    --scheme W4A16 \
    --iters 200 \
    --format auto_round \
    --low_gpu_mem_usage \
    --output_dir Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound
```

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.

## Caveats and Recommendations

Users (both direct and downstream) should be made aware of the risks, biases and limitations of the model.
